      - [List Prepayments For Subscription bundle](/api/openapi/subscription-bundle-invoice-account/listPrepaymentsForSubscriptionBundle): Lists a subscription bundle's prepayments.
      - [Create Subscription bundle Prepayment](/api/openapi/subscription-bundle-invoice-account/createSubscriptionBundlePrepayment): Adds a prepayment for a subscription bundle. This endpoint requires an `amount`, `details`, `method`, and `memo`. On success, the prepayment will be added to the group's prepayment balance.
      - [Issue Subscription bundle Service Credit](/api/openapi/subscription-bundle-invoice-account/issueSubscriptionBundleServiceCredit): Issues service credit for a subscription bundle. Credit will be added to the group in the amount specified in the request body. The credit will be applied to group member invoices as they are generated.
      - [Deduct Subscription bundle Service Credit](/api/openapi/subscription-bundle-invoice-account/deductSubscriptionBundleServiceCredit): Deducts service credit for a subscription bundle. Credit will be deducted from the group in the amount specified in the request body.
    - Estimate Invoices
      - [List Subscription bundle Estimate invoices](/api/openapi/estimate-invoices/listSubscriptionBundleEstimateInvoices): Lists estimate invoices with a `consolidation_level` of parent for the subscription bundle.

By default, estimate invoices returned on the index will only include totals, not detailed breakdowns for `line_items`, `discounts`, `taxes`, `credits`, `payments`, `custom_fields`. To include breakdowns, pass the specific field as a key in the query with a value set to true.
      - [Create Consolidated Estimate invoices](/api/openapi/estimate-invoices/createConsolidatedEstimateInvoice): Creates a consolidated estimate invoice asynchronously. It will return a 201 with no message, or a 422 with any errors. To find and view the new consolidated estimate invoice, you may poll the subscription bundle listing for estimate invoices; only one consolidated estimate invoice may be created per group at a time.

If the information becomes outdated, simply void the old consolidated estimate invoice and generate a new one.

## Restrictions

Estimate invoices are only available on Account Invoicing workspaces. To create a estimate invoice, the subscription must not be prepaid, and must be in a live state.
      - [Read Estimate invoice](/api/openapi/estimate-invoices/readEstimateInvoice): Returns the details of an existing estimate invoice.

## Restrictions

Estimate invoices are only available on Account Invoicing workspaces.
      - [List Subscription Estimate invoices](/api/openapi/estimate-invoices/listEstimateInvoices): Lists estimate invoices for a subscription. By default, results only include totals, not detailed breakdowns for `line_items`, `discounts`, `taxes`, `credits`, `payments`, or `custom_fields`. To include breakdowns, pass the specific field as a key in the query with a value set to `true`.
      - [Create Estimate invoice](/api/openapi/estimate-invoices/createEstimateInvoice): Creates a estimate invoice and returns it as a response. If the information becomes outdated, simply void the old estimate invoice and generate a new one.

If you would like to preview the next billing amounts without generating a full estimate invoice, use the renewal preview endpoint.

## Restrictions

Estimate invoices are only available on Account Invoicing workspaces. To create a estimate invoice, the subscription must not be in a group, must not be prepaid, and must be in a live state.
      - [Deliver Estimate invoice](/api/openapi/estimate-invoices/deliverEstimateInvoice): Delivers a estimate invoice programmatically via email. Supports email
delivery to direct recipients, carbon-copy (cc) recipients, and blind carbon-copy (bcc) recipients.

If `recipient_emails` is omitted, the system will fall back to the primary recipient derived from the invoice or
subscription. At least one recipient must be present, either via the request body or via this default behavior, so an
empty body may still succeed when defaults are available.
      - [Void Estimate invoice](/api/openapi/estimate-invoices/voidEstimateInvoice): Voids a estimate invoice that has the status "draft".

## Restrictions

Estimate invoices are only available on Account Invoicing workspaces.

Only estimate invoices that have the appropriate status may be reopened. If the invoice identified by {uid} does not have the appropriate status, the response will have HTTP status code 422 and an error message.

A reason for the void operation is required to be included in the request body. If one is not provided, the response will have HTTP status code 422 and an error message.
      - [Preview Estimate invoice](/api/openapi/estimate-invoices/previewEstimateInvoice): Previews the data that will be included on a given subscription's estimate invoice if one were to be generated. It will have similar line items and totals as a renewal preview, but the response will be presented in the format of a estimate invoice. Consequently it will include additional information such as the name and addresses that will appear on the estimate invoice.

The preview endpoint is subject to all the same conditions as the estimate invoice endpoint. For example, previews are only available on the Account Invoicing architecture, and previews cannot be made for end-of-life subscriptions.

If all the data returned in the preview is as expected, you may then create a static estimate invoice and send it to your customer. The data within a preview will not be saved and will not be accessible after the call is made.

Alternatively, if you have some estimate invoices already, you may make a preview call to determine whether any billing information for the subscription's upcoming renewal has changed.
      - [Create signup estimate invoice](/api/openapi/estimate-invoices/createSignupEstimateInvoice): Creates a estimate invoice to preview costs before a subscription's signup. This endpoint is only available for Account Invoicing workspaces and cannot be used to create consolidated estimate invoices or preview prepaid subscriptions. Like other estimate invoices, it can be emailed to the customer, voided, and publicly viewed on the ombrevix domain.

Pass a payload that resembles a subscription create or signup preview request. For example, you can specify addons, coupons/a referral, offers, custom pricing, and an existing customer or payment profile to populate a shipping or billing address.

A product and customer first name, last name, and email are the minimum requirements. We recommend associating the estimate invoice with a customer_id to easily find their estimate invoices, since the subscription_id will always be blank.
      - [Create signup estimate preview](/api/openapi/estimate-invoices/previewSignupEstimateInvoice): Creates a signup preview in the format of a estimate invoice to preview costs before a subscription's signup. This endpoint is only available for Account Invoicing workspaces and cannot be used to create consolidated estimate invoice previews or preview prepaid subscriptions. You have the option of previewing the first renewal's costs as well. The estimate invoice preview will not be persisted.

Pass a payload that resembles a subscription create or signup preview request. For example, you can specify addons, coupons/a referral, offers, custom pricing, and an existing customer or payment profile to populate a shipping or billing address.

A product and customer first name, last name, and email are the minimum requirements.
    - Events Usage Billing Segments
      - [List Segments for a Price option](/api/openapi/events-usage-billing-segments/listSegmentsForPriceOption): Lists segments created for a given price option, in order of creation.

You can pass `page` and `per_page` parameters in order to access all of the segments. By default it will return `30` records. You can set `per_page` to `200` at most.

You may specify addon and/or price option by using either the numeric ID or the `slug:gold` syntax.
      - [Create Single Segment](/api/openapi/events-usage-billing-segments/createSegment): Creates a new segment for a addon with a segmented metric. It allows you to specify properties to bill upon and prices for each Segment. You can only pass as many "property_values" as the related Metric has segmenting properties defined.

You may specify addon and/or price option by using either the numeric ID or the `slug:gold` syntax.
      - [Delete Single Segment](/api/openapi/events-usage-billing-segments/deleteSegment): Deletes a segment with the specified ID.

You may specify addon and/or price option by using either the numeric ID or the `slug:gold` syntax.
      - [Update Single Segment](/api/openapi/events-usage-billing-segments/updateSegment): Updates a single segment for a addon with a segmented metric. It allows you to update the pricing for the segment.

You may specify addon and/or price option by using either the numeric ID or the `slug:gold` syntax.
      - [Bulk Create Segments](/api/openapi/events-usage-billing-segments/bulkCreateSegments): Creates multiple segments in one request. The array of segments can contain up to `2000` records.

If any of the records contain an error the whole request would fail and none of the requested segments get created. The error response contains a message for only the one segment that failed validation, with the corresponding index in the array.

You may specify addon and/or price option by using either the numeric ID or the `slug:gold` syntax.
      - [Bulk Update Segments](/api/openapi/events-usage-billing-segments/bulkUpdateSegments): Updates multiple segments in one request. The array of segments can contain up to `1000` records.

If any of the records contain an error the whole request would fail and none of the requested segments get updated. The error response contains a message for only the one segment that failed validation, with the corresponding index in the array.

You may specify addon and/or price option by using either the numeric ID or the `slug:gold` syntax.
    - Advance Invoice
      - [Issue advance invoice](/api/openapi/advance-invoice/issueAdvanceInvoice): Issues an invoice in advance for a subscription's next renewal date. See our docs for more information on advance invoices, including eligibility for generating one; for the most part, they function like any other invoice, except they are issued early and have special behavior upon being voided.
A subscription may only have one advance invoice per billing period. Attempting to issue an advance invoice when one already exists will return an error.
That said, regeneration of the invoice may be forced with the params `force: true`, which will void an advance invoice if one exists and generate a new one. If no advance invoice exists, a new one will be generated.
We recommend using either the create or preview endpoints for estimate invoices to preview this advance invoice before using this endpoint to generate it.
      - [Read advance invoice](/api/openapi/advance-invoice/readAdvanceInvoice): Returns the advance invoice generated for a subscription's upcoming renewal. There can only be one advance invoice per subscription per billing cycle.
      - [Void advance invoice](/api/openapi/advance-invoice/voidAdvanceInvoice): Voids a subscription's existing advance invoice. Once voided, it can later be regenerated if desired.
A `reason` is required in order to void, and the invoice must have an open status. Voiding will cause any prepayments and credits that were applied to the invoice to be returned to the subscription. For a full overview of the impact of voiding, [see our help docs]($m/Invoice).

      - [List Exported Invoices](/api/openapi/api-exports/listExportedInvoices): Lists exported invoices for a provided `batch_id`. Use pagination to control responses returned from the server.
